name: beyond-islands
description: Interactive islands (Preact) for the Go site. Output goes to ../static/js and is embedded in the Go binary.

scripts.build: npm run clean && esbuild src/islands.js --bundle --splitting --format=esm --minify --target=es2019 --jsx=automatic --jsx-import-source=preact --outdir=../static/js --chunk-names=[name]-[hash] && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('node_modules/leaflet/dist/leaflet.css','../static/js/leaflet.css')"
